evals.prompt: We have three rental ownership changes landing next sprint and nobody can tell which system owns the publish state. Can you draw it?
evals.expected_output: Choose the smallest diagram that exposes the ambiguity — a state or sequence view of the publish path rather than a decorative architecture overview — and state which ownership/trust boundary the diagram makes explicit.

evals.prompt: Add a diagram to the PR description for a bug fix in the ticket checkout webhook.
evals.expected_output: Prefer no diagram when the change is a local fix. If a diagram is warranted, use a sequence diagram of the webhook retry/duplicate path because that is where the failure and recovery behaviour actually lives.

evals.prompt: I sketched a flowchart last week but the code has since changed and it no longer matches.
evals.expected_output: Update the diagram to match the code before continuing, or drop it. Never force the implementation to match a stale diagram — an out-of-date diagram is worse than none.
